portal.info: Vula ukudilivariwa ngosixhobo sakho senguqulelo ukufumana ubungqina bokubonelela. Ubungqina obuthintelwe ngaphandle kwesignali bugcinwa kwesi sixhobo kwaye buyanyushwa ngokuzenzekelayo xa ubuyela ekuxhumaniseni — awusoze ulahle ukudilivariwa.
